title: Ben Rich called UFOs 'unfunded opportunities'

tellings.quote: you told me once that Ben Rich would refer to UFOs as unfunded opportunities.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the British aviation journalist Nick Cook once told him something about Ben Rich, who ran Lockheed's Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design division of the American defence company Lockheed. According to Cook, Rich used to call UFOs unfunded opportunities, meaning projects nobody had paid for yet. Michels tells it because, if true, it would mean a top aircraft designer saw UFOs as technology that could be built.
